It schedules azkare.11 exclusively for Y86 after two days. All three ADM/DIP/MIL options set azkare_united_townships and change the mission tree, but do not directly invoke azkare.221. Obtaining the unification flag requires completing azkare_the_lady, which triggers the Y86-only azkare.9 with a single option. That event schedules azkare.215, which schedules azkare.216. The four dynasty-naming options in azkare.216—Saetae, Hiderionzuir, Myazuir, and Tonanzuir—have no separate trigger and all set hiderion_son_birth in after, so pursuing the unification flag entails starting the son sequence; a player who does not pursue unification may skip that mission chain. When Hiderion dies while still reigning in Y86, the general on_death_election event list schedules azkare.221, whose trigger additionally requires tag=Y86 and has_ruler_flag=is_hiderion. The Son option also requires hiderion_son_birth to have remained in place for at least 7300 days. If that threshold is unmet, the Elf and Sikai options remain available. azkare.213 removes the son flag if its long-duration conditions are met and the event fires; azkare.220 only increases half_elf_dauloph-related benefits and is not a prerequisite for the Son option. Choosing Elf can avoid Z62, while choosing Sikai invokes change_tag=Z62 only if the unification flag remains set. This establishes only the scheduling chain: an early death of Hiderion or changes to Tag or ruler conditions mean that the scheduled birth event is not guaranteed to execute.
